chars.DAUGHTER: a Moroccan young woman of about 23 with long loose dark wavy hair, wearing an oversized mustard-yellow hoodie and light blue jeans
chars.MOM: a Moroccan mother of about 50, round friendly face, wearing an emerald-green house djellaba and a loosely tied white headscarf
chars.DAD: a stocky Moroccan father of about 55 with a thick grey moustache and short grey hair, wearing a brown wool djellaba over a white shirt and reading glasses

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan apartment in Kenitra, seen from the hallway doorway where the daughter stands, head-to-waist framing: MOM caught mid-step walking reluctantly toward the salon, glancing back over her shoulder with a worried, unwilling grimace and hands clasped; in the salon behind her DAD sits on a sedari couch reading a newspaper, unaware. Light comic mood, warm light.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan apartment hallway. DAUGHTER playfully pushes MOM forward by both shoulders toward a closed wooden door, grinning nervously; MOM digs her heels in, eyes rolled up, comic resistance. Head-to-waist, faces visible.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan apartment hallway. DAUGHTER holds MOM's hands and pleads with big hopeful eyes, explaining passionately; MOM sighs, softening, one hand on her heart, deciding to support her. Warm, slightly comic.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan apartment hallway. DAUGHTER presses her ear flat against a closed wooden door, crouching, eyes wide, biting her nails, holding her breath in suspense. Comic tense mood. Full face visible.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan salon with sedari couches. DAD jumps up from the couch shouting with his mouth wide open, newspaper flying out of his hands, glasses slipping down his nose, pointing at MOM in disbelief; MOM steps back with palms raised. Over-the-top cartoon reaction, comic.
